meta.description: Produce and interpret PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, and PHATE plots for high-dimensional omics data with explicit preprocessing, reproducibility, quantitative validation, publication outputs, and interpretation limits.
meta.execution_note: Executed all nine archived round-1 inputs plus two genuinely new round-2 inputs. The eleven-input count intentionally exceeds the ordinary complexity cap to satisfy the re-audit regression requirement.

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical and visual claims are traceable to saved execution logs, generated artifacts, or independent recomputation; no study result or citation was fabricated.

practice_boundaries.detail: Outputs are research visualizations and method checks; none diagnoses, prescribes, or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Raw-count HVG ordering, library-size normalization, seed semantics, neighborhood limits, batch checks, category encoding, and trajectory caveats remained methodologically sound across all eleven inputs.

code_usability.detail: All valid Python and R workflows executed; invalid contracts stopped intentionally; the shipped example produced five valid PDFs on full, 12-condition, and 20-condition inputs; seven focused provider tests passed.

functional_suitability.note: Covers PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, PHATE, preprocessing, method selection, quantitative validation, exact output paths, palettes through 20 categories, and interpretation limits.

reliability.note: Strict shape, metadata, and raw-count validation is deterministic and recoverable by correction and rerun; messages are specific but not structured as machine-readable error codes.

performance_context.note: The 220-line main skill uses progressive references well; the deliberately comprehensive shipped comparison remains more computationally expensive than method-specific recipes.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, method rules, five-file contract, palette guard, deterministic loading-label placement, and failure modes are explicit and executable.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts, truthful categorical legends, an explicit >20-category escape hatch, and publication-ready output guidance make the workflow discoverable and usable.

security.note: No credentials, network calls, user-string code execution, destructive operations, or sensitive-data logging are present.

maintainability.note: Concise main guidance, two focused references, a CLI example, and seven regression tests cleanly separate concerns and support verification.

agent_specific.note: Triggering, progressive disclosure, deterministic reruns, and stop conditions are strong; the mixed advisory-plus-CLI skill intentionally has a broader output surface than a narrow composable API.

key_strengths: The runnable workflow enforces raw-count HVG selection before normalization and produces five exact-path publication PDFs.
Method-specific reproducibility guidance correctly distinguishes openTSNE, Rtsne, uwot, Scanpy, and PHATE seed semantics.
Categorical colors are deterministic and one-to-one through twenty categories, with a hard stop and actionable fallback above twenty.
PCA loading-label placement uses rendered bounding boxes to prevent overlap deterministically.
Interpretation limits are operationalized through neighbor-retention, batch-mixing, and high-dimensional validation rather than visual storytelling.
